title: Lab shell opens with the three Captions cards and both views
description: app.html hosts the production side panel. Captions view has Source, Task & Languages and Actions & Preview cards with the transcript lanes; History holds Export and Helper has its own tab (board D02). Notes view opens and Captions comes back.
steps: See the Captions view with 3 cards (source, languages, actions with transcript lanes)

title: Live captions: interim line is replaced by the final line with direction tags
description: While someone speaks, a draft line shows; when the final arrives it replaces the draft. Two-way mode tags each line ID to EN or EN to ID.
steps: Send an interim subtitle and see it
Send two final subtitles in opposite directions
See both lines with direction tags and no leftover draft

title: Pipeline error shows a friendly card with technical detail
description: A pipeline error must not be silent: the status line shows a title, the error box shows the same title and the raw message under technical detail.
steps: Send an error message to the panel
See the error box, status line title and raw message

title: Export captions as SRT, VTT and TXT
description: After one final subtitle, the Export card enables. SRT has index and comma timestamps, VTT starts with WEBVTT and a blank line, TXT has the plain text. Filenames carry the language pair.
steps: Send a final subtitle (1.25 s to 3.5 s)
Open the History tab (export lives there since board D02)
Open each download and read its content

title: Export options CRLF and BOM persist after reload
description: Turning on CRLF and BOM changes the export bytes (BOM first, CRLF line ends) and the choice survives a page reload; the OS-default button resets both.
steps: Open the History tab (export lives there since board D02)
Export SRT and check the bytes
Press OS default and see both cleared

title: Settings modal fits the screen, is centred and closes
description: The Settings modal has a single card inside the screen at 1280 px and at phone width, with engine, theme and language controls, and the close button closes it.
steps: See one centred card with engine, theme and interface-language toggles
Resize to 390 px wide and see it still inside the screen

title: Notes view: load the sample meeting, see the register, export TXT and MD
description: The Notes view starts empty, the sample button fills it with a meeting with decisions and actions, and the TXT and MD buttons download a file with the meeting title.
steps: See the meeting and its items
Download TXT and MD and read them

title: Native helper card: offline fallback shows a warning, fixture shows the engine
description: Choosing the Native engine shows the helper card. With a healthy helper the status names the engine; when the helper is down the status says not running and the model warning appears.
steps: With a fixture helper press Recheck and see the engine name
Switch the mock helper to offline and Recheck
See not running and the warning
Choose Browser engine and see the card hide

title: Minutes Register: empty state, then load sample data
description: With no meetings the empty state shows. Loading sample data opens the workspace with a meeting title, strip counts and rows in the register.
steps: See the meeting header and register rows

title: Minutes Register: add a decision and an action
description: Add item opens a form; saving a decision and an action with an owner adds both to the register, bumping the type chip counts.
steps: Add item, type Decision, fill text, add
Add item, type Action, fill text and owner, add
See both rows and the chip counts go up by one

title: Minutes Register: type chips and search narrow the list
description: Toggling a type chip limits the register to that type; typing in search limits rows to matches; clearing restores them.
steps: Toggle the Decision chip and see only decisions
Clear it, open the dock (it starts as an icon since board D01), search for a word and see fewer rows

title: Minutes Register: export Markdown, CSV and JSON
description: The Export menu offers MD, CSV and JSON; each download is named after the meeting and has parseable content.
steps: Open Export and pick each format

title: Minutes Register: view dock minimises and restores
description: The view dock starts as an icon while the navigator is open, shrinks to an icon and opens again on click; the tabs inside stay reachable.
steps: See the dock start as an icon (board D01) and open it
Click it and see the dock open

title: Rust engine: /health answers and notes round-trip
description: The engine on a free loopback port answers /health with ok, accepts a note by POST /notes, lists it by GET /notes and exports it as text.

title: Rust engine: refuses foreign origins and non-loopback Host, allows the lab and extension
description: A web page on another site must not read local notes: foreign Origin gets 403 without an allow header; a non-loopback Host gets 403; the lab origin and a chrome-extension origin are allowed and echoed.
steps: GET /health with a chrome-extension origin and the lab origin

title: Inbox: close an item, undo it
description: Minutes > Inbox lists open items; Close moves one to Finished and the open count drops; Undo restores it.
steps: Press Close on the first row
Press Undo and see it return

title: Projects: librarian pause and resume
description: The Librarian can be paused (no suggestions) and resumed; no meeting changes without Accept.
steps: Press Pause and see no suggestion card
Press Resume and see the cards return

title: Highlights: counts, needs you, source line
description: Minutes > Highlights shows counts of decisions, actions, questions and risks, the Needs you list, the source line and Issue MoM.
steps: See the source line and Issue MoM

title: Draft options use the meeting transcript first
description: When a meeting has its own transcript, Draft options read it first and the panel says so.
steps: Give the newest meeting a transcript

title: Recap email: build, open draft, copy, nothing sent
description: Trust Recap email, press its chip in Notes: a card shows recipients with a known email, who has none, a preview, Open mail draft (a mailto link) and Copy. Nothing is sent.
steps: Trust the three add-ins in Settings > Add-ins
Press Recap email in the Notes strip
See recipient count and the no-email names
Press Open mail draft and see one mailto link

title: Glossary: needs input, add, CSV import and export, remove
description: The Glossary panel in Notes lists the series terms. An empty term shows a needs-input message; a term is added and shown; CSV export has the header; import reports good and skipped rows; a term can be removed.
steps: Load sample data and trust Glossary
Press Add with no term and see the message
Add a term with heard-as spellings
Export CSV and read the header
Import a CSV with one bad row and see the counts

title: Due dates to calendar: one .ics of open actions
description: Press the chip: one .ics file downloads with an all-day VEVENT per open action that has a due date, CRLF lines folded at 75 bytes; the card says how many were saved.
steps: Load sample data and trust the add-in
See the count on the card

title: Add-ins tab: how-to for each new add-in, locked until trusted
description: Before trust nothing from the three add-ins appears in Notes; each add-in shows its how-to text and a Needs trust state in Settings > Add-ins.
steps: See no add-in strip in Notes
Select each new add-in and read its how-to text and state
